name: NACA 64A204 left wing, model scale 1:8: 10% chord (xfoil)
data_origin: Original user left-wing planform scaled uniformly 1:8 (all lengths /8 and area /64); model MAC=0.578625 m; root/tip chords=0.695/0.125 m. NACA 64A204 from the recorded PDAS source is used at every section with zero twist. Angles refer to the nominal NACA chord/global X; the geometric-LE chord rotation is corrected in XFOIL local alpha. Mach=0.2; model-MAC Reynolds numbers 3e6, 5e6, 8e6; angles 0,1,2 degrees. These Reynolds numbers are not divided by 8. Independent 2D XFOIL strips do not solve 3D sweep flow. Geometry comes from supplied sections; coordinates and reference lengths must already be at wind-tunnel model scale. Eta spans only the supplied Y stations; no unprovided wing root, tip or full planform is inferred. All coordinates are interpreted in metres. Upper/lower curve order must match the section contour order. Angle mapping is explicit in the workflow settings. XFOIL is a 2D section method without crossflow. XFOIL computes its own Cp from geometry; imported Cp is not prescribed to its viscous solver. The undisturbed calculation allows natural transition; the requested trip is not imposed in XFOIL. DUMP supplies integral quantities, not resolved u(y). Low-Mach Hk/theta reconstruction is approximate. Re_k reconstruction uses constant freestream kinematic viscosity; DUMP does not provide nu(y) or wall temperature. Laminar confirmation is predicted by the solver transition model, not established experimentally.

calibration.notes: Subsonic equiaxed distributed grit; NASA TN D-3579. Mach cap 0.95 is a tool guard.

warnings: Preliminary trip sizing, not a prediction or guarantee of transition or downstream turbulent development.
Only the supplied discrete conditions are covered; no guarantee between sampled angles of attack or Reynolds numbers.
Sweep sets placement geometry only. Crossflow, attachment-line transition, and 3D streamline histories are not solved.
Height is exposed protrusion above the model surface, including mounting effects; verify actual installed height.
Height margin and k/delta99 cap are user design policies, not universal transition correlations.
Integral mode reconstructs u(y) from theta and shape factor; this is not a resolved wall-normal solver profile.
XFOIL DUMP H/Hk formats are checked and converted to Hk; theta and freestream viscosity are transferred approximately at low Mach.
Solver cases must converge and the requested station must remain attached and upstream of natural transition.
